item.title: Blood, Sweat & Bonfires: River parishes prepare for Christmas Eve bonfires - L'Observateur
item.description: The design for this year’s River Parishes Christmas Eve bonfire was unveiled last week at the Leroy D. Williams Memorial Library in Reserve.

item.title: Pastors’ Coalition team up to deliver free Thanksgiving meals to families in St. John’s Parish - L'Observateur
item.description: Faith leaders, donor organizations, and community members gathered Saturday, Nov. 22, at the New Wine Christian Fellowship in Laplace to help families in need ahead of Thanksgiving

item.title: Riverside Academy alum hosts first Turkey giveaway, distributes 150 turkeys to local families - L'Observateur
item.description: Riverside Academy graduate and UL Lafayette football player Elijah “Bill” Davis returned home Saturday to give back to the community that raised him, hosting his first Thanksgiving turkey giveaway at Riverside Academy in Reserve.

item.title: St John Parish Deputy shot by brother on Thanksgiving, suspect arrested after car chase in Jefferson Parish - L'Observateur
item.description: According to Jefferson Parish Sheriff’s Office officials, the victim was shot and killed during an incident involving his brother.

item.title: St. John Parish Sheriff's Office mourns deputy killed in off-duty shooting - L'Observateur
item.description: The St. John the Baptist Sheriff's Office confirmed that SJSO Deputy Shaquille Guerin was killed in Waggaman on Thanksgiving Day, and his brother faces second-degree murder charges.

item.title: $700K bond set for man charged in Thanksgiving killing of St. John's deputy - L'Observateur
item.description: Bond has been set for a man accused of fatally shooting his brother, a St. John the Baptist Parish Sheriff’s deputy, on Thanksgiving Day in Waggaman. Court records show that 32-year-old Darius Guerin was arrested in connection with the killing of his brother, Deputy Shaquille Guerin. His total bond was set at $700,000, including $500,000 […]

item.title: CPKC Holiday Train to stop in Laplace, bringing music and cheer - L'Observateur
item.description: The Canadian Pacific Kansas City (CPKC) Holiday Train will bring Christmas cheer to Northwest Louisiana with a scheduled stop in Laplace on Tuesday, Dec. 2, 2025.

item.title: Boutte business owner arrested on multiple narcotics and vape charges - L'Observateur
item.description: A Boutte business owner was arrested on multiple drug charges after an investigation found large quantities of Kratom, THC vapes, and marijuana at his businesses and storage unit.
